messages.subject: Re: mediation analysis with categorical variables
parts:
Hi, Paul.

First, your tables are difficult to read--can you post them in either plain-text for a fixed-width font, please?

Second, in a parallel mediation case, it's standard practice to let all of the disturbances of the mediators covary with each other. Otherwise you're incorporating the strong hypothesis that medul is the only cause of the relations among them.

If I'm reading right, that will saturate your model and make the structural relations unfalsifiable, but it's the best I've got.

Pat
